proposal: Demin storage 2 x 1,250 m3 (cycle make-up plus about 24 h of water injection), demin plant sized for continuous water injection at 50 % LDO load, plus a connection for mobile demin trailers. No price change.
question: Water injection needs about 80 t/h of demineralised water at base load on LDO. ER-09.02 requires storage for 72 h of LDO operation (about 5,800 m3) on top of 3 days of cycle make-up: a very large tank for a fuel used less than 500 h/year.
response: Accepted as proposed: demin storage 2 x 1,250 m3, demin plant sized for continuous water injection at 50 % LDO load, and a connection for mobile demin trailers; no price change.
subject: Demineralised water for LDO water injection
